ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Disqualified")), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Re-Nurture"), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Re_Nurture_Reason_CC__c)), AND( ISPICKVAL(Re_Nurture_Reason_CC__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(Re_Nurture_Comments_CC__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Re-Nurture reason is required to mark status as Re-Nurture. If the reason is ‘Other’, please provide Re-Nurture Comments
